preamble.summary: Psalm 16 — 'You will not abandon my soul to Sheol' (cited at Acts 2:27, 13:35 in Peter's and Paul's resurrection sermons). Tracks MT.
preamble.notable_variants: Cited Christologically at Acts 2:27 / 13:35 as resurrection prophecy. No significant content variants. Minor orthographic variation only (the standard Qumran plene-spelling tendency).
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary attestation; no continuous DSS coverage.
